newsitem.title: USA: Crown American sees under 20 pct div taxed.
newsitem.headline: Crown American sees under 20 pct div taxed.

text.p: Crown American Realty Trust said Thursday that it expects the current taxable portion of its 1997 common share dividends to be under 20 percent, with the remainder being a non-taxable return of capital.
This estimate is considerably lower than the 35 to 45 percent range reported for the three previous years.
The reduction is directly related to the recently completed senior preferred share offering.
Under current tax regulations, the company's earnings and profits are first allocated to the preferred share dividends, with any remaining amounts allocated to the common share dividends.
The company also estimates that 100 percent of 1997 preferred share dividends will represent currently taxable income.
The company normally reports the final taxable portion of its dividends in mid-January of the following year.
